semantics.mapping: For every i from 0 through 99, out[i] = in[99-i]
semantics.timing: Combinational bit reversal; original interface has no clock or reset
semantics.initialization: No stored state or specified initial value; output follows input including unknown bits

numeric.interpretation: Bit permutation without arithmetic or signed interpretation

verification.oracle: Reverse a textual binary representation of the applied input independently of DUT indexing
verification.cases: Zeros, ones, every walking one and walking zero, asymmetric patterns, randomized patterns, X and Z propagation
verification.sampling: Check after a 1 ns combinational settling interval
verification.termination: Fatal on mismatch or bounded timeout; PASS only after all cases
